quarterly_data.signal: Rockwell's Q3 fiscal 2026 earnings release (8-K): sales were $2,313 million versus $2,144 million; organic sales growth by region was North America 12%, EMEA 7%, Asia Pacific 8% and Latin America (3)%, and nine-month organic growth was 9%. Updated fiscal 2026 guidance: diluted EPS $12.72 - $13.02 (prior $11.88 - $12.48) and a reported sales midpoint of ~$9.0B (prior ~$8.9B; prior reported and organic growth range 5% - 9%). Q3 Adjusted EBITDA was $565 million (24.4% margin) versus $461 million.
